description: Get a single post by ID with full details including platform statuses, labels, media files, recurring schedule info, and metrics. For a thread post, `threadParts` holds the parts and `threadMediaFiles` resolves the media they reference: that media is NOT in `mediaFiles`, which carries only the media on the post itself. Use this when the user references one specific post by its ID.
name: get_post

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

title: Get post
